author: Vox
description:
What happens to a society when its members become increasingly wary of one another, and relationships break down based on gender lines?

Subscribe to our channel! http://goo.gl/0bsAjO

In today’s episode, guest host Christine Emba speaks with pollster and writer Dan Cox about his new book Generation Uncoupled: America's New Gender Divide and the Crisis of Human Connection. They consider how and why men and women in America are growing apart, rising safety concerns among young women, and the widening political divide on gender lines.

Host: Christine Emba, columnist and author
Guest: Dan Cox, Director of the Survey Center on American Life at the American Enterprise Institute and author of Generation Uncoupled.

author: Vox
description:
Is politics shaping the identity of younger generations? 

Dan Cox, author of Generation Uncoupled, sits down with The Gray Area guest host Christine Emba to discuss how, being raised with high expectations and fewer traditional social structures like marriage or parenthood, Gen Z and Millennials are finding structure and meaning through political engagement.
